interpretation: The film TIFF carries a strong, broad-band, low-edge-correlated high-frequency display-chain signature beyond the camera RAW, but correct registration provides no predictive advantage over a shifted control because the nonnegative digital-to-film high-pass fit collapses to zero. The signal is therefore observable but not identified as transferable emulsion structure; scanner noise, sharpening, quantization and process remain inseparable.
next_leaf: Require repeat scans or multiple independently exposed same-density film patches before fitting spatial structure; stop this one-pair route.
claim_ceiling: One registered 8-bit TIFF versus camera-processed RAW display-chain texture negative; not emulsion grain, stock calibration, product, redistribution or commercial-use evidence.
